## Why

S0 RI-02 found the public API answering questions it cannot answer:

- `/v1/dossier/{any}` returned the same 25 unrelated subjects for any
  scope (`LIMIT 25` fallback in `PgReadStore.dossier`) — C3 NEW-1.
- `/v1/coverage` said `complete:true` with zero records evaluated —
  C3 NEW-10.
- `bytes_available` was `true` for any `public`-tier capture, including
  connector `synthetic` run records that never carried bytes.
- The four hand-seeded OKC fixture source ids (`deflock`,
  `okc_council_statement`, `okc-contract-c241032`, `osm`) could reach
  live answers — J4 NEW-6.
- `/terms` named a "SIG editorial board" and "counsel" that do not
  exist — E2 H-5.
- `sig_read_public` held blanket `SELECT ON ALL TABLES` over
  `public` + `inference` (P24.1) — `person`, the domain projections,
  `resolution`/`relationship`, `extraction`, `ingest_run*`,
  `evidence_blob`, the review/camera-site machinery, every vocab
  registry and both `inference` tables were all public-readable —
  J1 NEW-9.
- No response identified the live spine it answered from — A-20=a.

## What this does

- **Honest scope 404s (C3 NEW-1).** `PgReadStore.dossier` returns
  `None` for an unheld scope — the `LIMIT 25` unrelated-subject sample
  is gone (a jurisdiction dossier is P35.57's after JUR-02a).
  `ReadStore.coverage_for` returns `list | None` (`None` = scope not
  held). Both routes raise `ScopeNotAvailableError` → typed 404
  `{"detail": "scope not available", "code": "scope_not_available",
  "scope": …}` — the `SearchIndexError` error shape.
- **Honest coverage (C3 NEW-10).** `coverage_statement.complete` is now
  `evaluated > 0 and not_evaluable == 0`; `empty_coverage` on point
  resources answers `complete=false` too — nothing that evaluated zero
  records claims completeness.
- **Honest byte availability.** `CaptureMetadata` gains
  `capture_classification` (the P32.2 marker); `bytes_available` is
  claimed only for `public` tier **and** `actual` (proven byte-bearing).
  `EvidenceResponse` gains additive `bytes_unavailable_reason`
  (`tier:{v}` / `classification:{v}`); pre-P32.2 metas degrade to
  `False`, never a guess.
- **Fixture sources never serve (J4 NEW-6).** Two exclusion layers at
  the `PgReadStore` seam: a claim stamped
  `evidence_origin='seed_fixture'` (the P32.3/SIG-TRUST-004 marker
  `ops.seed` writes on every fixture claim) is never served; and a
  claim whose selected establishing occurrence is fixture-sourced is
  dropped even unstamped. Distinct-source joins (entity/dossier/search
  attribution) drop the ids and the stamped claims; a fixture-source
  capture 404s. The compute-on-read contradiction/task set runs over
  the same filtered claims. `InMemoryStore` — the demo fixture store —
  is untouched.
- **`/terms` (E2 H-5).** The fabricated referral clause is removed;
  the re-identification prohibitions and the revocation remedy stand
  (SIG-API-013). Nothing new is asserted (B-2 copy batch #1 pending).
- **Live-spine basis label (A-20=a, extends SIG-REL-010).** New
  pure-ASGI `BasisLabelMiddleware` (outermost, composes with
  `IdentifierAliasMiddleware`): every response carries
  `X-SIG-Basis: live-spine` (+ `X-SIG-Basis-Watermark` when the store
  knows one, `X-SIG-Basis-Release` when the service is pinned), and
  every JSON/JSON-LD object body gains `"basis": {"type": "live-spine",
  "watermark"?, "release_id"?}` — error bodies included; a 404 is a
  live-spine answer too. `ReadStore` gains `spine_watermark()`; the PG
  probe is the bounded O(#facets) read, `SIG_RELEASE_ID` configures the
  release pin, `None`/`absent` discloses "not pinned" — never a
  fabricated value.
- **Least-privilege grants (J1 NEW-9).** New sqitch change
  `public_read_allowlist` (deploy/revert/verify + plan entry): revokes
  the blanket from `sig_read_public` and re-grants exactly the 15-table
  §37 read surface `PgReadStore` queries plus the P32.5 column-limited
  `publication_disposition` tombstone. `sig_export` is untouched.
  Inherited-access fallout is restored directly, not by inheritance:
  `sig_materialize` keeps the read scope its materializers and the
  curation queue actually use (`resolution`, `relationship`,
  `camera_site_*`, `review_campaign*`, `ingest_run[_completion]`, the
  three resolution vocab tables, `inference.derived_fact`);
  `sig_intake_bridge`/`sig_recovery` keep `append_only_guard` SELECT
  (the `claim_immutable` trigger reads it on every claim UPDATE — the
  belief-close write broke without it). The revert enumerates the real
  pre-change set — a fresh `ALL TABLES` grant would wrongly re-open
  `assertion_quarantine`, `entity_identity_key`, `ingest_run_capture`,
  `recovery_application` and the `human_eval` relations.

## Tests

- `tests/api/test_api_honesty.py` (new, 19 tests): typed 404 bodies on
  both scope routes; held-vs-zero-evaluated coverage; byte availability
  across tier×classification; `/terms` names no board/counsel; the
  basis header + field enumerated over every public route incl. errors,
  JSON-LD and HTML; watermark/release disclosure when configured.
- `tests/api/test_store_pg.py`: seeds a `deflock` +
  `seed_fixture`-stamped claim and asserts it appears in no served
  answer (claim 404, capture 404, values filtered, source lists clean);
  dossier now targets a held entity scope.
- `tests/db/test_public_read_allowlist.py` (new): exact granted-set
  equality via `aclexplode` + effective-access check; column-limit
  check; a real `SET ROLE` SELECT on every allowed relation; denial
  probes on 32 internal relations (`person`, `evidence_blob`,
  `resolution`, `review_item`, `entity_identity_key`,
  `assertion_quarantine`, `recovery_application`, `human_eval_*`,
  `inference.*`, …); inference USAGE and sequence checks; the
  `sig_materialize` preservation set.
- `tests/evidence/test_tiers.py`: the honest byte gate across
  tier×classification.
- `make check` · `SIG_REQUIRE_DB_TESTS=1 uv run pytest tests/db` (551)
  · `SIG_REQUIRE_DB_TESTS=1 uv run pytest tests/api/test_store_pg.py`
  (16) · e2e — see the `ci:` line in `docs/build/runs/P34.25.md`.

## Deviations / deferrals

- `empty_coverage` also answers `complete=false` (evaluated 0 claims
  no completeness anywhere).
- Release-namespaced search carries the same `live-spine` label per the
  ticket's literal text ("every API response"); release parity remains
  P35.57's.
- A process-level unhandled-500 surface (Starlette `ServerErrorMiddleware`,
  outside the user middleware stack) is the only response the label does
  not reach; every mapped error (404/422/503) is labelled.
- No OM-20, no live stage, no production mutation. The API roll is
  P34.46's; slip past 2026-10-21 is a disclosed deferral, not silent.
